description: Derived outcome-to-food relationships generated from foods' mechanism profiles (food-mechanisms.json) matched against each outcome's candidateMechanisms (outcomes.json). This file is DERIVED, not hand-curated: it must be regenerated whenever food-mechanisms.json or outcomes.json change. Score is contribution-weighted (sum of matched mechanisms' strength/5 x confidence, each mechanism discarded below a 0.5 contribution threshold), not a coverage ratio, so outcomes with long candidate-mechanism lists are not structurally penalised relative to outcomes with short ones. 'coverage' (matched/required) is retained as an informational field only and does not drive ranking or evidenceScore. evidenceScore normalises the raw contribution score to 0-100 against the top-scoring food for that specific outcome; scores are only ever comparable within one outcome's list, never across outcomes.
generationRule: sum(strength/5 x confidence) over each food's mechanisms that are also in the outcome's candidateMechanisms, discarding any single mechanism contribution below 0.5, then normalised 0-100 against the top food for that outcome.
